We are a  small, non profit rescue saving the lives of stray dogs and keeping them safe until adoption/foster. 
Supporting spay and neuter campaigns 🐾
We couldn't do this work without your support! Together we are stronger 💪 🐾

"Dogs are our best friends, they are always loyal and love us unconditionally.
Whether we are rich or poor, strong or weak, sad or happy, they will be with us until the very end."

The less time we have to spend on fundraising for these animals, the more time we have to actually go out there and get them off the streets.  Vet bills are extremely expensive, and you are making it all possible when you support our efforts! If you would like to donate then our Paypal is - paypal.me/Noahsarkdogrescue

Please follow our social media for regular updates on rescues & adoptions.

Facebook - https://www.facebook.com/NARR4Paws
Twitter - https://twitter.com/NoahArkrr
Donate - http://paypal.me/Noahsarkdogrescue

Thank you

Noah's Ark Team
